title: FormSchema Grammar
description: The standard structure for a schema describing a data entry form.

title.description: The title for the form (e.g., 'Create New Project').

properties.description: Defines each field in the form.

required.description: An array of property keys that are required.

title.description: The label for the form field.

type.description: The data type of the field.

uiWidget.description: A hint for which UI component to render.

enum.description: If uiWidget is 'select', this provides the options.

description.description: Help text to display below the field.
